messages.author: 6a61cf5209600060
messages.subject: INLA function not working for DHS
parts:
Hello, All, 
 I'm just asking if you might have a familiarity with INLA examples, specifically the Ohio Lung Cancer
http://www.statistica.it/marta/stbook/Chapter7.R.

I was just trying to adopt the same INLA using demographic health surveys (DHS) data. But, after preparing my data in the same structure with the one in the example and wrote similar code. But, it keeps on giving me the below error. please advise if you may have any familiarity.



data <- read.csv(paste("/Users/fikrewoldbitew/Google Drive/StuntingEthiopia/stuntybyregion_ethio.csv",sep=""))

region1 <- data$region

ethio.adj <- paste("/Users/fikrewoldbitew/Google Drive/StuntingEthiopia/ethio.graph",sep="")

form_par <- y ~ 1 + f(region,model="bym",graph=ethio.adj, constr=TRUE) + f(region1,year,model="iid", constr=TRUE) + year

model.par <- inla(form_par,family="poisson",data=data,E=E, 
                  control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE), 
                  control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE))


NAs introduced by coercionError in if (n.from.graph <= 0) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed


Thanks!
